summary: Package resolves sole dependency from non-registry URL with install lifecycle hook
details: multi-acct@4.999.999 pins its sole dependency `vector-cursor-stream-engine` to an arbitrary HTTPS tarball URL at `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine` in both package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json, bypassing the npm registry. The shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so on `npm install` npm fetches the tarball from that host and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The URL is unpinned (no version, no integrity hash) and points at a domain unrelated to any established publisher, so the code that runs at install time is whatever the operator of artifacts.yosiroute.com serves at the moment of install. The suspiciously-high version number (4.999.999) is consistent with a dependency-confusion / registry-hijack lure shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
